sources.text: Carson Laboratory Principal Investigator: Dennis A. Carson, MD dcarson@health.ucsd.edu (858) 534-5408 Center for Novel Therapeutics (CNT) 9310 Athena Cir, La Jolla, CA 92037 About the Lab About the Lab About Our Research Our research team focuses on the discovery and development of novel drugs that enhance the function of the human immune system, with minimal side effects. These new drugs should improve the efficacy of vaccines against Covid-19 and influenza in patients with compromised immune systems. The drugs are also being tested as immunotherapeutic agents in patients with cancer.
